deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve Cardano ecosystem KPIs including monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue development of KPI tracking from self-reported dashboards toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Use an independent multisig and administrator validation before Cardano Builder DAO receives milestone payments.
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury after completion of approved work, governance processes, or funding activities.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds first received and administered by an independent council composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to continue and expand the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is presented as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism intended to support projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 through measurable KPIs.
The proposal claims its funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The proposer states that Version 1 and Version 2 of the DAO KPI dashboard were built, with Version 2 moving toward KPI tracking tied directly to live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO claims it has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
The proposer states Round 1 funded 20 companies, involved 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, distributed 5,541,335 ADA, and achieved 83% governance participation.
The proposer states Round 2 funded 14 companies, added 18 new DAO members, and achieved 88% member participation.

The proposal claims the DAO has created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain with transparency.

The proposal says official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.
The proposal states administrator-held ADA will be kept in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to a stake pool operator, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The proposer states the CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after the first two governance rounds and provides an AdaStat transaction link.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue and expand a milestone-administered, KPI-driven builder funding mechanism, but the anchor text itself leaves budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode analysis incomplete.
